text:
Ellie T: Hey team — Ellie here, first day! 🎉 I just finished HR stuff and have a few quick setup questions: where do I request the dev laptop image, who helps with VPN/SSH access, and where do you usually grab stickers? Also keen to meet folks — open to a quick intro chat later.

Marc D: welcome, Ellie! :wave: For laptop image + shipping, file an IT ticket at https://support.redwood.ai/new-laptop (pick 'developer image'). For VPN + SSH, @eng-infra handles keys. Ping them in #eng-infra and cc me if it stalls.

Hana K: Hey Ellie — hi! I can pair on VPN/SSH today at 3pm PT or tomorrow morning. DM me which works. Also, onboarding runbook is pinned in #new-hires (search "onboarding-runbook").

devex-bot: Welcome, Ellie! Your automated onboarding checklist has been created: https://console.redwood.ai/onboard/2049991234. Steps remaining: request laptop, complete identity verification, add SSH key. Reply "done" here once you finish a step to update your checklist.

Ellie T: Thanks Marc/Hana — I'll submit the IT ticket now. Quick question on SSH keys: do we prefer ed25519 or rsa?

Marc D: We prefer ed25519 for dev machines. Example ~/.ssh/config we use:
```
Host redwood-bastion
  HostName bastion.redwood.internal
  User ellie
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
  ForwardAgent yes
```

Juan G: Stickers are in the main office reception + I put a small pack on your desk this morning (if you're on-site). If remote, order here: https://orders.redwood.ai/stickers — select "new-hire pack" and include your address.

Alex R: We're doing a small team lunch Wednesday at 12:30 in the office kitchen (or Zoom if remote). Bring your favorite snack or ramen rec — Ellie, you'll be the judge of best ramen brand later 😄 :ramen:

Hana K: Also, FYI: key contacts — @Marc D (infra), @Juan G (ops), @Alex R (eng lead), and me for DevEx pairing. If anything blocks your access after IT ticket, loop us in and we can escalate.

Ellie T: Amazing, thanks everyone! Submitting ticket now and will ping #eng-infra once I have the ticket number. Excited to be here — happy to grab that lunch on Wednesday. :raised_hands:
